stmt.title: Monthly statements
stmt.lead: One sheet per month that gathers the weekly settlements (starting on Mondays). You can print it or save it as a PDF.
stmt.empty: No statements yet. They appear here month by month once weekly settlements are closed.
stmt.printHelp: In the print dialog, choose Save as PDF as the destination (printer) to get a PDF file.
stmt.weeks: {n, plural, one {{n} weekly settlement} other {{n} weekly settlements}}
stmt.noWeeks: There are no weekly settlements in this month.
stmt.note: Amounts are in KRW. Payouts are made by the payment provider to the seller's sub-merchant account.
stmt.mailNote: When SogaeBank turns statement emails on, each month's statement is emailed only once.

perf.title: Performance trend
perf.sub: Leads received, contact views, response speed, lead conversion, fees and settlements by period. Only your own partner data is shown.
perf.moneyHidden: Visible only to the owner and staff with settlement permission.
perf.note: Leads, views and response speed count by the day received, closed deals by the day the consumer confirmed, fees by the day billed and settlements by the day paid (Korea time). Other partners' numbers are not shown.
